notes: Modified cash basis. The governmental Statement of Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances is now fully trimmed: trimmed p7 (report p18, added in this re-trim; scanned) prints the row labels and the General, Depreciation, Employee Benefit, Special Building and QCPU columns, p8 (report p19) the Activities Fund, Adjustments and Total Governmental Funds columns, and pp9-10 (report pp20-21) the continuation. The printed labels on p7 match the receipt and disbursement labels already recorded (checked against the source PDF earlier), so only the obsolete label_source notes were removed; amounts stay on the Total column pages. Total column roll-forward: 1,745,227 + 3,499,317 - 3,317,533 - 30,000 = 1,897,011. The Statement of Activities prints governmental general receipts 3,225,016 + operating grants 277,720 = 3,502,736 and transfers (33,419); the fund statement total column is 3,419 lower in Other State Receipts and shows transfers out 30,000 (see report_discrepancies). The statement's Adjustments column eliminates the 140,000 General-to-Depreciation transfer from Regular Pupil Transportation (249,199 General column -> 109,199 total column), so the total column has no hidden transfer; in detail the General Fund schedule line 2700 (printed 249,199) is split into 109,199 spending plus a -140,000 other financing line (split_from, review). Governmental transfers out 30,000 per total column; the General Fund schedule shows 33,419 transfers to School Nutrition and 3,419 'Other State Receipts' (statement total column nets 3,419 against the transfer). Business-type = School Nutrition Fund (pp10-11, detail p20): 7,319 + receipts 77,188 - disbursements 112,588 + transfers 33,419 = 5,338 (matches Statement of Activities p4); measure recorded as cash (net position equals cash in bank). Ending_cash is the governmental roll-forward balance 1,897,011 (total assets 1,913,178 include 10,829 liability due to employees and business-type cash 5,338 is inside the total column). Detail: General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (revenue by source, spending by function not itemized by object, transfer as other financing); other fund schedules recorded per fund (pp12-18); Activities Fund recorded account by account from the p21 schedule (zero cells omitted; transfers net to zero) and the one-line Activities Fund budget schedule (p19) omitted; lines with zero actual and zero budget omitted. Statement of Activities (pp2-4) not added to detail (same totals as the fund statement; no double counting). Depreciation, Employee Benefit, QCPU and School Nutrition schedules print no total disbursements line so no expenditure totals recorded for them (Employee Benefit and QCPU print no total receipts). Page numbers remapped after the v7 re-trim. Other State Receipts 230,587 split (pp13-14, 18): Homestead Exemption 20,610, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 5,190, other state aid 204,787; Other 92,088 split into Activities Fund receipts 75,855 (Extracurricular Receipts) and the General Fund's 16,233 by its pp13-14 lines; Activities Fund detail receipts are Extracurricular Receipts (fixed 2026-10-27). Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p6), Total Governmental Funds column; business-type cash 5,338 and net position 5,338 kept from the Statement of Net Position (p1), whose total column gives the totals (1,913,178 / 10,829 / 1,902,349).
